item.title: South Bend one of 24 winners of Bloomberg Philanthropies Mayors Challenge
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- South Bend and its mayor, James Mueller, are one of 24 pairs of cities and mayors to win the Bloomberg Philanthropies Mayors Challenge for 2026.

item.title: LaSalle Grill set to close permanently on Wednesday
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The LaSalle Grill in South Bend confirmed they will be closing for the foreseeable future on Wednesday, Feb. 25.

item.description: WASHINGTON DC -- President Donald Trump is set to give his first State of Union speech of his second term to a joint session of Congress on Tuesday at 9 p.m.

item.title: Plymouth Police continue to investigate false bomb threat
item.description: PLYMOUTH, Ind. -- The Saint Joseph Health System Medical Center in Plymouth is back open after a fake bomb scare forced an evacuation overnight.

item.title: St. Joseph County Council approves an updated Land Bank agreement in collaboration with Michiana Area Council of Government
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Ind. -- The St. Joseph County Council has approved a resolution on a land bank partnership with the City of South Bend aimed at addressing hundreds of abandoned homes and vacant lots across the city.

item.title: BREAKING: One person shot on North Brookfield Street in South Bend
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The South bend Police Department confirmed officers are responding to a shooting at the 1000 block of North Brookfield Street.

item.title: Fighting Irish defeated by Blue Devils 100-56
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The worst loss for Notre Dame since 1989 took place Tuesday night at Purcell Pavilion as Notre Dame takes on the Blue Devils 100 to 56.
